baseline.rules: 2 old exposure maps, all four seats, every available step; compare file, replies, cash, init<=20 s, step<=3 s, slow>1s <=3 per tape, excess<=5s, elapsed<=1500s. Retain any miss. One pinned core and RLIMIT_AS=512MiB with BLAS1, container isolated from network; actual host cgroups differ; no ranked game.
baseline.start: external before docker run including launch; step before JSON serialization through received decoded action. RSS ru_maxrss reports process peak. New container and process per tape, not cold host page cache.

run_order: sorted two archive files per map, each both parent+candidate serially. Alternate arm order each seat. All four tapes retained.
boundaries: Host controller and child policies pinned to CPU 2, stock image BLAS1, request serialization to parsed action. Cold child per tape, warm host cache. Historical parent timings used client core 3, so same-run parent is measured again. No current full-opponent duel; identical archived observations for both arms. Official 1.5 CPU/512 MiB for hosted qualification requires readback of resource controls.
